task.title: Gate worker failures on authoritative terminal envelopes

scope.owned_layer: Supervisor worker-failure evidence admission, classification entry, boot-reconciliation behavior, and regression evidence.
scope.not_changing: Provider credentials, account/quota grouping, retry thresholds, reviewer policy, runtime-state JSON, live process signals, and product code.

contract.plain_text_gate: A worker_runner terminal failure status is required before plain transcript lines can enter regex classification.
contract.provider_envelope_gate: Structured provider streams independently admit only explicit terminal result/error/failure envelopes and rejected rate-limit control events.
mixed_trust_exclusions: assistant prose without a terminal control envelope
contract.missing_process_fallback: Quota-like log text without a runner/provider terminal envelope remains failure_kind missing_process and never opens a quota dispatch pause.

boot_reconciliation.unenveloped_missing_copilot: missing_process preserved and no provider pause

verification.result: checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon provisioned and dependency imports verified

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py -k 'DetectWorkerFailureTests or RuntimeLeaseReconciliationTests or AllowedRateLimitNoticeTests or pause_dispatch_for_reaped_worker'

review.required_gate: Pantheon canonical review gate on the exact PR head
